design.purpose: A warm two-tone scarf for one adult, worked in chunky wool with the photographed 15 mm hook. Confirm enough yarn in each skein for 24 rows before starting; skein quantity is not known from the photo.

steps.c: Place the green yarn on the work surface.
Ch 13. Row 1: hdc in 3rd ch, 10 hdc. 11 hdc.
Rows 2-8: ch 2, turn, 11 hdc in green.
Rows 9-16: ch 2, turn, 11 hdc in green.
Rows 17-24: ch 2, turn, 11 hdc in green.
Place the blue yarn beside the work.
Rows 25-32: join blue, ch 2, turn, 11 hdc.
Rows 33-40: ch 2, turn, 11 hdc in blue.
Rows 41-48: ch 2, turn, 11 hdc. Fasten off.
Cut the blue yarn, leaving a 15 cm tail.
Weave the green tail through nearby stitches.
Weave the blue tail through nearby stitches.
Trim any tail end flush with the edge.
